introduction: Follow Flazoh’s bandit bounty and explore the valley’s woodland, faerie courtesy and court, quiet hermit, hungry villager, young warrior, village trade and guarded civic stories.
orientation: Discover the valley, follow its wooded paths and hill road, and meet the faeries, hermit and people of Minthka. Keep a known route back as you explore.
Flazoh offers a bounty for the human bandits’ shivs. Hi and hello share one response; asking both words does not complete two quests.
Prepare one exact bandit shiv loose in your inventory. An equipped or packed-away shiv does not satisfy this current preparation, and a different sword cannot replace it.
A shiv recovered from its source or an exact copy supplied by another player fits Flazoh’s request. A supplied copy does not claim your own first recovery or personal bandit kill.
The local sneaky bandit is different from the human bandits that supply this shiv. Find the correct item rather than assume all bandits carry the same weapon.
Offer the exact shiv when Flazoh can accept it. His accepted bounty stays recorded after the shiv is spent; current coin holdings alone do not prove a completed bounty or confirm payment.
The old sign and faerie gate descriptions suggest courtesy as the way forward. Speaking, unlocking, opening the gate, crossing and returning safely are different actions.
The faerie court has inner doors and residents with their own possessions. Reaching the king or holding his jewellery does not yet prove a useful service to the court.
The healing clearing and wildlife suggest longer stories about refuge and care. Passive recovery, ordinary combat and loot do not yet count as completed rescue or habitat work.

Esroh values his quiet home. The poor villager needs help, and the boy dreams of being a warrior. Their descriptions guide exploration; useful favors, feeding and training need further integration before they can be recorded as completed quests.

Minthka’s bakery, grocer and magician offer their listed goods. A successful purchase, receiving an item and using it for someone’s benefit are different outcomes; carried merchant equipment is not automatically for sale.
The leader’s home and guarded closet have doors, keys and a dangerous dog. Keep their costs and a way back; gaining access is separate from an authored civic favor or a surviving return.

contacts.name: a furry white rabbit
contacts.description: This is a small, white rabbit with very soft fur.

contacts.name: a brown squirrel
contacts.description: This is a tiny, brown squirrel with a bushy tail.

contacts.name: a tiny sparrow
contacts.description: This is a very beautiful, tiny bird with brown body and wings.

contacts.name: a small rodent
contacts.description: This is a small, brown rodent that looks almost like a mouse.

contacts.name: a white wolf
contacts.description: This is a very beautiful, majestic looking wolf with snow white fur.

contacts.name: a wise old owl
contacts.description: This is a very large owl with brown feathers and bright yellow eyes.

contacts.name: a sneaky bandit
contacts.description: This is a small man dressed in black leather and a mask to hide his identity.

contacts.name: a wandering gypsy
contacts.description: This is an old, scruffy woman with strangly, grey hair.

contacts.name: a seasoned warrior
contacts.description: This is a scruffy human dressed in leather.

contacts.name: a young cleric
contacts.description: He smiles at you and says, 'Do you know the way to the town of Verzanan?'.

contacts.name: an evil magician
contacts.description: He growls at you, 'What are you looking at?!?!?!'.

contacts.name: a wise, old man
contacts.description: He says, 'Did I tell you the story about when I slayed a dragon bare-handed?'.

contacts.name: a deer
contacts.description: This is a large, beautiful deer with soft brown and grey fur.

contacts.name: a small grey fox
contacts.description: This is a small fox with grey fur and small white blotches around its eyes.

contacts.name: a merchant
contacts.description: This is a tall, human merchant trying to earn an honest living.

contacts.name: a moon faerie
contacts.description: This faerie glows with an inner radiance much like the full moon on a dark night.

contacts.name: an iridescent faerie
contacts.description: The iridescent faerie swirls in a myriad of colors blending each color into itself seeming to blur.

contacts.name: an opal faerie
contacts.description: The opal faerie glints like the fog that leaves morning dew, and you see glints of fire-light dancing inside.

contacts.name: a rainbow faerie
contacts.description: The rainbow faerie is splashed with vivid colors of the rainbow brightly hued.

contacts.name: an emerald faerie
contacts.description: This is a tiny faerie that emits bright breen glints of light which sparkle vividly.

contacts.name: a glass faerie
contacts.description: This faerie is totally transluscent and the images behind it are blurred from the refraction of light passing through.

contacts.name: a spider faerie
contacts.description: This faerie is obsidian black with hair that looks like fine silk.

contacts.name: the royal king of the faeries
contacts.description: The royal king of the faeries has a regal aura about him.

contacts.name: the faerie cleric
contacts.description: The faerie cleric is surrounded by a bright, white aura.

contacts.name: the faerie mage
contacts.description: The magical essence of this faerie brings forth power from the earth, and channels it into the air around it as magical energy.

contacts.name: Esroh the hermit
contacts.description: Esroh welcomes visitors while enjoying solitude. Meeting him can guide a respectful visit; a useful favor needs further integration.

contacts.name: a village guardian
contacts.description: This is a large warrior hired to protect the town of Minthka.

contacts.name: a village salesman
contacts.description: He looks like he would bargain for hours and hours to try to make a deal.

contacts.name: a village poor man
contacts.description: The poor villager begs for help and appears hungry. Meeting him, buying food and making him better off are different outcomes; his deeper assistance needs further integration.

contacts.name: the village blacksmith
contacts.description: He looks very muscular from pounding iron all day.

contacts.name: the village baker
contacts.description: The village baker is covered in flour as he is busy preparing his bread.

contacts.name: the village grocer
contacts.description: The village grocer smiles and says, 'What would ya like?'.

contacts.name: the village magician
contacts.description: The village magician says, 'Yes? How may I help you?'.

contacts.name: the village leader
contacts.description: The village leader is a large man about 6'1" tall and weighing 300 lbs.

contacts.name: a village boy
contacts.description: The village boy dreams of becoming a warrior and asks for a sword in his description. This does not yet create an accepted sword quest or recorded training outcome.

contacts.name: a village girl
contacts.description: She is a petit little thing with long, curly hair.

contacts.name: the guardian dog
contacts.description: The dog is hardly small enough to fit in the closet -- his neck is so thick his master uses belts for a collar -- the normal dog collar type things just don't work since they're too small.

contacts.name: Flazoh the bounty hunter
contacts.description: Flazoh fears the human bandits and offers a bounty for their shivs. Hi and hello share one briefing. One exact recovered or supplied bandit shiv fits his request; a personal kill is not a separate requirement.

stories.title: Claim Flazoh’s bandit bounty
stories.summary: Flazoh accepts one exact bandit shiv for his promised coin bounty. A recovered or supplied copy fits. Current preparation, accepted turn-in, personal sourcing and confirmed payment have distinct evidence.

steps.hint: Bring one exact bandit shiv loose in your inventory. Recovered or supplied copies fit. Equipping or packing it does not satisfy this preparation, and this row does not claim a personal kill or first source recovery.

Offer the exact shiv when Flazoh can accept it. The accepted turn-in stays recorded after the material is spent. Confirming the promised coin payment is separate from current preparation and coin possession.
